<function name="HasBrakePedal" parent="Vehicle" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns whether this vehicle has a brake pedal. See <page>Vehicle:SetHasBrakePedal</page>.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether this vehicle has a brake pedal or not.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
